exposure: Length of hospital stay after birth
finding: Length of hospital stay after birth and maternal colonization were associated with subsequent childhood carriage of ciprofloxacin-resistant E. coli, while antibiotic use, acid suppression, sex, mode of delivery, and maternal perinatal antibiotic use were not.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with subsequent childhood carriage of ciprofloxacin-resistant E. coli.
